column1: # RapidJSON at 06d58b9e — the commit OpenTimelineIO v0.17.0 pins — reading each number
# as OpenTimelineIO 0.17.0 parses, Reader::Parse<kParseNanAndInfFlag>, inside `[` and `]`:
# the text, then the callback (or the error code and offset) of a build with
# -ffp-contract=off, then of one with -ffp-contract=on, which fuses `d * 10 + digit`.
# Built by Apple clang 21 at -O2 for arm64. Error codes: 3 kParseErrorValueInvalid,
# kParseErrorNumberMissExponent; a double as its bits.
# The spellings the export writes for a rate whose shortest it misreads, in both forms; the shortest
# of the three rates no spelling the export tries writes; and counts past ⌊2^54 / 10⌋, as integers.
